name: docx-html-converter
description: Convert DOCX to HTML with styles, tables, lists. WASM + Rust. Includes calculate_html for contentEditable page recalculation. Works in Node.js, React, Next.js, Vite.

scripts.build: node scripts/rm-pkg-package-json.cjs && node scripts/run-with-rustup-toolchain.js wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir pkg && node scripts/ensure-pkg.cjs
scripts.build:dev: node scripts/rm-pkg-package-json.cjs && node scripts/run-with-rustup-toolchain.js wasm-pack build --target web --dev --out-dir pkg && node scripts/ensure-pkg.cjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build:for-publish && npm run test
scripts.golden:test:full: node -e "require('child_process').execSync('cargo test golden', { env: { ...process.env, GOLDEN_FULL: '1' }, stdio: 'inherit' })"
